purpose: all-event recognition, independent of highlight selection

scoring_plan.primary: unweighted macro F1 across supported event types
also_report: per-type TP/FP/FN, precision, recall, F1 and support
background false positives per observed minute
proposal recall and detection recall before highlight selection
scoring_plan.no_reference_support: not measured for recall/F1; never a passing class
scoring_plan.release_gate: macro F1 >=0.7 AND per-type precision and recall >=0.7 with adequate support; otherwise fail or insufficient evidence
scoring_plan.matching: one-to-one, same-label temporal match; tolerance/IoU policy frozen after timing audit
scoring_plan.paired_events: a possession change may contain both steal and turnover; retain each reference separately
scoring_plan.confidence: per-prediction model confidence is separate from evaluation quality and statistical uncertainty

sampling_plan.diagnostic: freeze examples stratified by all 12 types across both games; declare label-informed sampling
sampling_plan.validation: freeze continuous source-time intervals; score every reference inside, including repeated events and negatives; source-driven proposals
sampling_plan.rare_types: report available support and insufficient evidence; never infer reliability from one example
